card.name: Partway through long drug terms
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a long word that is not yet complete, most often the 'ast' in rosuvastatin. Also seen in words like nongovernmental, enzyme and diuretic.

modes.label: Other long medical or formal words
modes.description: Middle pieces of words such as enzyme, diuretic and nongovernmental.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are a mix of unrelated languages and topics, so the output effect is unclear.
